description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 or 1.60 each), causes [Imperil Holy 20%] and [Imperil Water 20%], grants [Awoken Altruist], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode (Water, Holy)] and [Sacred Breath Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Altruist
description.text: Holy and Water abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy and Water abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Water, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Water]/[Attach Holy] after using a Water/Holy ability

description.name: Sacred Breath Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Sacred Breath after using three Water or Holy abilities
